FCU.notes: Ceiling/wall/cassette mounted air conditioning unit (2-pipe or 4-pipe). Brands: Daikin FXDQ/FXSA/FXNQ, Mitsubishi PEFY/PCFY/PFFY, Toshiba RAV, Ability AIR EVO270P (4-pipe). Code pattern: FCU-00-01. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend + S70992-02-Schedule FCU 4Pipe.xlsx]

BS.notes: Daikin VRV branch selector — switches individual FCUs between heating and cooling mode. Models: BS-8-Q14A (8 port), BS-10-Q14A (10 port). NOT a water booster set. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks _CEMS_Dai BS-8-Q14A, _CEMS_Dai BS-10-Q14A]

BSB.notes: Daikin VRV individual branch selector box. Model: BS1Q10A7V1B. Dimensions: 388x326x207mm. [Confirmed: sets.dxf block]

HRU.notes: Mechanical ventilation with heat recovery (MVHR). Brands: Mitsubishi Lossnay LGH series, Toshiba VN-250SE/VN-800SE/VN-1000SAE. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Mitsubishi BC Boxes & Lossnay']

VAV.notes: Variable air volume terminal unit controlling airflow to individual zones. Code pattern: VAV-00-01. [Confirmed: sets.dxf block _CEMS_Flow Rate VAV Anno]

VRV.full_name: Variable Refrigerant Volume / VRF Outdoor Unit
VRV.notes: Outdoor condensing/heat pump unit for VRV/VRF system. Brands: Daikin REYQ/RZAG, Mitsubishi PURY/PURY-EP. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks PURY-P400YNW, Daikin REYQ8-12]

CDU.notes: External refrigerant condensing unit. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'FCUs & Condensers']

AHU.notes: Central air handling unit serving multiple zones. [Project drawings — not in sets.dxf]

CAHU.notes: Ceiling-mounted air handling unit. [Project drawings — not in sets.dxf]

CRU.notes: Dedicated precision cooling / CRAC unit for server or comms rooms. [Confirmed: sets.dxf block _CEMS_Drip Tray CRAC Units]

SER.notes: Wall/ceiling split A/C indoor unit for server or comms room. Brands: Mitsubishi PKA-M100KA, Daikin FTXM/FAA series. Paired with SERCU condensing unit. [Confirmed: TD Bank project SER-02-01/02/03 + S70992-02-Schedule Comms AC.xlsx]

SERCU.notes: Outdoor condensing unit paired with a SER indoor unit. Brands: Daikin RXM/AZAS series. [Confirmed: TD Bank project + S70992-02-Schedule Comms AC.xlsx]

MER.notes: Precision A/C unit for main equipment/plant rooms. Brand: Stulz ASD series. [Confirmed: TD Bank project MER-02-01/02]

MERCU.notes: Outdoor condensing unit paired with a MER indoor unit. [Confirmed: TD Bank project]

EPH.notes: Electric radiant or convector panel heater. [Confirmed: sample2.pdf EPH-02-01/02]

RAD.notes: Hot water panel radiator. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Radiator']

CT.notes: Open or closed-circuit cooling tower for heat rejection. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CT/02/01-12]

CTM.notes: Master / primary unit in a multi-cell cooling tower. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CTM-01]

CTE.notes: Expansion / satellite unit in a multi-cell cooling tower. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CTE-02]

CTX.notes: Cross-flow type cooling tower cell. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CTX-01]

CTP.notes: Pump set integral to a cooling tower system. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CTP-01]

CTS.notes: Slave / secondary unit in a multi-cell cooling tower. [Confirmed: TD Bank project CTS-01]

WP.notes: Submersible or inline pump for waste water / condensate drainage. Brands: Pump Technology DrainMinor PTL30, DrainMajor PTL60/PTL60(H), Grundfos Sololift2 WC-3, Saniflo Saniaccess 3. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks + S70992-02-Schedule Waste Pump.xlsx]

WH.notes: Electric point-of-use water heater or unvented hot water cylinder. Brands: Ariston Andris Lux (6L–30L), Heatrae Streamline, Megaflo. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks + S70992-02-Schedule Water Heater.xlsx]

SAN.notes: Macerator pump for WC/shower waste. Brands: Saniaccess 3, Sani-shower pump. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks _CEMS_Saniaccess 3, _CEMS_Sani-shower pump]

ZT.notes: Filtered, chilled and/or boiling water tap. Brand: Zip BCS1201125 Hydrotap. [Confirmed: sets.dxf blocks _CEMS_Zip tap, ZIP BCS1201125 hydrotap]

DSF.notes: Ceiling-mounted fan to destratify warm air in high-ceiling spaces. Brand: Airius Standard 10-25. [Confirmed: sets.dxf block Airius Standard 10-25]

ATT.notes: Rectangular in-duct acoustic attenuator / silencer to reduce fan and airflow noise. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'ATTENUATOR / SILENCER' + S70992 + S71013 legends]

EF.notes: Room extract fan for tea points, copy rooms, WC areas etc. [Confirmed: sets.dxf attribute EF=EF + _CEMS_Extract Fan Detail block]

IEF.notes: Compact inline duct-mounted extract fan. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'In-line Extract Fan']

SEF.notes: Dedicated extract fan for server or specialist rooms. Brand: FlaktWoods JM Aerofoil. [Confirmed: TD Bank project SEF-02-01 to SEF-02-05]

WCEF.notes: Dedicated extract fan for WC / toilet areas. [Confirmed: TD Bank project + sets.dxf Extract Fan Detail mentions WC extract]

RG.notes: Return air or relief grille. [Confirmed: sets.dxf code RG-01-01 in model space]

EG.notes: Ceiling or wall-mounted extract air grille. [Confirmed: sample2.pdf EG-02-02 to EG-02-06 + TD Bank project]

LG.notes: Door or wall louvre / transfer grille. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Louvre & Transfer Grille']

FG.notes: Floor-mounted supply or return grille. [Confirmed: TD Bank project FG-2A]

FD.notes: Intumescent fire damper at fire/smoke compartment boundaries, fitted with access panel. Manufacturer: BSB FD Series (60-min rating). [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend + S70992-02-Schedule Fire Damper.xlsx]

FSD.notes: Combined fire and smoke damper. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Fire & Smoke']

MFSD.notes: Electrically actuated combined fire and smoke damper connected to fire alarm. [Confirmed: sample2.pdf MFSD-02-01 to MFSD-02-03]

VCD.notes: Manual duct balancing / volume control damper. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'VCD']

MCD.notes: Electrically actuated volume control damper with PIR control. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'MCD' + _CEMS_MCD Arrangement block]

NR.notes: Prevents backflow of air in ductwork. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Non-Return']

NRD.notes: Non-return / check damper preventing backflow. Same device as NR; 'NRD' code used in some drawing sets. [Confirmed: S70992 + S71013 legends 'NON RETURN DAMPER (NRD)']

HB.notes: Duct-mounted hot-water or electric heater battery for post-heating of supply air. [Confirmed: S70992 + S71013 legends 'HEATER BATTERY']

HBT.notes: Duct-mounted hot-water heater battery. Alternate code for HB used in some drawings.

C.notes: Wall-mounted room controller / set point adjuster for AC unit. Manufacturer: Schneider Electric SpaceLogic SLA (TD Bank project). [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'AC Controller' + S70992-02-Schedule AC Controller.xlsx]

S.notes: Room or duct temperature sensor. S2xx/S3xx numbering used in drawings. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Temp Sensor']

LD.notes: Water leak detection panel (1–16 zone). Brand: Andel Floodline (1-zone, 4-zone, 8-zone, 16-zone). [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend + S70992-02-Schedule Leak Detection.xlsx]

PIR.notes: PIR occupancy/presence sensor used with MCD damper control and FCU switching. Confirmed in sets.dxf: _CEMS_MCD Arrangement wiring diagram.

SP.notes: Electrically actuated solenoid shut-off valve on condensate or chilled water pipework. [Confirmed: sets.dxf _CEMS_Leak Detection Schematic 'SOLENOID VALVE CONTROL PANEL / SP']

GD.notes: R32 refrigerant gas detector. [Confirmed: sets.dxf layer '_Leak Detection R32' + TD Bank project GD-02-01]

PO.notes: Capped or blanked pipework outlet / connection point. [Confirmed: sets.dxf legend 'Pipework Outlets']
